title: CandyTop — SugarCraft
description: CandyTop: btop-style terminal system monitor for PHP. Port of aristocratos/btop — cpu, mem, disks, net, process, containers and GPU/NPU boxes, btop themes and config, Linux and FreeBSD collectors.
ogDescription: Terminal system monitor — cpu, memory, disk, network, process, container and GPU boxes with braille graphs, gradient meters, btop's 42 themes and btop-compatible config. Port of btop.
detailMeta: port of btop system-monitor tui charts linux freebsd
